data.body: Fixed in commit 72901ba238. Root cause B (no SYNC marker on inbound CREATE) addressed by bridge/_inbound_api.write_create_events writing SYNC.json marker + self-heal pass for legacy CREATE-without-SYNC tickets. Root cause A (single-pathed outbound dispatch) addressed by adding cron schedule to outbound-bridge.yml. After this commit lands on main and inbound bridge runs once, jira-dig-1575/1576 will get backfilled SYNC markers and the queued in_progress STATUS event will push to Jira on next outbound run.
